paper_metadata.title: EXAONE 4.5 Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: This technical report introduces EXAONE 4.5, the first open-weight vision language model released by LG AI Research. EXAONE 4.5 is architected by integrating a dedicated visual encoder into the existing EXAONE 4.0 framework, enabling native multimodal pretraining over both visual and textual modalities. The model is trained on large-scale data with careful curation, particularly emphasizing document-centric corpora that align with LG's strategic application domains. This targeted data design enables substantial performance gains in document understanding and related tasks, while also delivering broad improvements across general language capabilities. EXAONE 4.5 extends context length up to 256K tokens, facilitating long-context reasoning and enterprise-scale use cases. Comparative evaluations demonstrate that EXAONE 4.5 achieves competitive performance in general benchmarks while outperforming state-of-the-art models of similar scale in document understanding and Korean contextual reasoning. As part of LG's ongoing effort toward practical industrial deployment, EXAONE 4.5 is designed to be continuously extended with additional domains and application scenarios to advance AI for a better life.

extraction_data.innovation: Joint multimodal reinforcement learning: conducts RL across both text and vision modalities simultaneously to enhance reasoning capability, differing from prior approaches that typically process modalities separately or rely on unimodal RL; GRPO with IcePop setting and zero-variance filtering: adopts Group Relative Policy Optimization with IcePop and filters out groups whose advantages are all zero to preserve training stability and improve policy optimization, differing from standard GRPO implementations that may suffer from unstable advantage estimates.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Multimodal pretraining over visual and textual modalities
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: General domain image-text pairs, interleaved image-text documents, document understanding datasets, OCR-centric samples, text-only data from K-EXAONE pipeline
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Offline preference optimization, Multimodal instruction tuning, joint multimodal reinforcement learning
extraction_data.extension: Context extension embedded directly into the supervised fine-tuning stage to achieve a stable and effective context length of 256K tokens without compromising cross-modal alignment.
extraction_data.research_problem: Vision-Language Models for industrial intelligence and document understanding
extraction_data.application: Vision-language reasoning, STEM/puzzle solving, document understanding, coding, mathematical reasoning, agentic tool use, instruction following, long-context understanding, multilingual tasks
extraction_data.training_corpus_size: 420B image tokens, 400B text tokens (Stage 1); 225B image tokens, 110B text tokens (Stage 2)
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Mathematics, coding, knowledge, instruction-following (text); general visual understanding, STEM reasoning, charts, OCR, document understanding, multi-image (vision)
extraction_data.supported_language: Korean, English, Spanish, German, Japanese, Vietnamese
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Hybrid attention and Grouped Query Attention (GQA), 2D Rotary Positional Embedding (2DRoPE) for vision; 1D RoPE for text, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) in vision encoder
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Native multimodal pretraining over visual and textual modalities
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: Dual-mode: NON-REASONING mode for general-purpose tasks, REASONING mode for complex problems
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Synthetic captioning pipeline optimizing for visual information richness; synthetic OCR images with diverse backgrounds; synthetic grounding and counting data prioritized to mitigate noise
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Task-specific reward functions for vision tasks; same reward system as previous model for text tasks
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Vision encoder integrated into language decoder
extraction_data.vision_encoder: 1.2B parameter vision encoder trained from scratch, Custom-built 1.2B-parameter vision encoder
extraction_data.benchmark_result: AIME 2026: 2nd overall; LIVECODEBENCH V6: best among compared models; τ2-BENCH: 72.0; IFBENCH: 62.6; IFEVAL: 89.6; MMMU: 78.7; MMMU-PRO: 68.6; MATH-VISION: 75.2; WE-MATH: 79.1; AI2D: 89.0; OMNIDOCBENCH V1.5: 81.2; BLINK: 68.7; CHARXIV(RQ): 71.7
